title: Capture signed-app install custody
objective: Close intended-device helper and protected signed-app install execution custody, including compiler-output origin through the first protected snapshot, before flagship composition.

blockers.reason: Current production successor is #3142 exact f4863bded2f9ca9b41f1e5d17c3f37a592efbe3f on defeated #3056@b8653985. It has now re-earned terminal SUCCESS on Signed App Install Custody 31577777765, Field Build Provenance 31577777848, and Main Selective Graft 31577777828; Xcode 31577778204 is SKIPPED and is not acceptance. The dedicated-UID/APFS quiescence/read-only-freeze direction is materially stronger, but production acceptance remains blocked by two independent lifecycle/credential defects. First, `_structured_credentials(build_uid, build_gid, ())` and the canonical real-Xcode witness assume source-level `extra_groups=[]` proves zero effective supplementary groups; sibling real-macOS #3137 exact 9bcb/run 31577666923 and 4446/run 31578243211 demonstrate that on this runner logical empty/reset vectors can retain ambient kernel groups. #3142 never records its fresh build child's actual os.getgroups(), so its zero-supplementary-authority claim is unearned. Require actual child UID/GID/raw-group attestation against the freshly created build principal baseline and fail closed on unexpected groups. Second, `_remove_local_build_identity` remains best-effort unchecked pkill/dscl cleanup with no process/user/group absence postcondition. Successful promotion must fail closed unless the build UID has no live process and the build user/group are no longer resolvable. Review 4914595652 records the new credential finding; reviews 4914432389/4914440707 and comment 5264243977 record retirement. PHYSICAL NO-GO.

Validation-only #3131 exact 98fdc404048812f6d3af6791710c57ece21dafd3 / run 31547634222 remains accepted evidence for a distinct build UID/GID, normal non-forced APFS detach, byte-identical read-only remount, and field/root/former-build mutation denial with physicalAuthorityCreated=false. It does not mechanically attest the production child raw kernel supplementary-group vector or verified principal retirement, so those remain production-specific blockers rather than reasons to discard the APFS architecture.

The ancestor da41 Field red was exactly a stale old-topology source assertion. f486 retargeted the permanent Field source contract to dedicated identity/APFS/quiescence/read-only-remount invariants while forbidding retired capability/process-group markers, and exact Field run 31577777848 is terminal SUCCESS. Do not reintroduce the old chmod/capability topology.

#3142 still executes the real private Tuya build-window guard plus Automatic Apple signing/provisioning inside the dedicated build identity. Its green canonical Signed Install path proves synthetic compiler-output/APFS custody, not access to the field user's mode-restricted Tuya inputs, Apple Development keychain identity, provisioning updates/device registration, or final signed iOS workspace. #3137 has now established a narrower validation direction in which the real field UID plus its exact captured pre-sudo baseline groups can receive a fresh primary-GID path capability without ordinary field processes gaining that capability, but current validation still has not reached direct codesign on its simplified native fixture and is not production #3142. If real signed field feasibility is red, introduce a narrow custodied signing/input handoff; never restore field-user writable compiler-output authority.

After #3142 closes observed child credential attestation, verified principal retirement, and real signed/private feasibility, signed-install still must converge with selected-Xcode/build authority, accepted private identity plus its source-root consumer seam, Final-GO Darwin authority, runtime accessibility, and the current app-visible Capture product on one unchanged exact composition. Re-run protected-stage, signature/profile/CoreDevice, Field/Main/Xcode, adversarial, visual/runtime and final procedure gates there. No validation or package-only result authorizes installation or scooter interaction.
